expectations.evidence: Report opens with a fenced ```mermaid graph LR``` block showing all 5 packages and the shared/contract relationships.
Per-package inventory sections exist for client, server, mcp, reviewer-core, e2e, each with a total size figure.
Full markdown table per package with Dependency/Type/Declared range/Installed version/Size columns, every direct dependency listed individually.
Every table row has separate 'Declared range' (e.g. ^15.1.3) and 'Installed version' (e.g. 15.5.19) columns; text explicitly notes when they coincide vs diverge.
Section 4 is a P0-P5 priority table plus a closing summary paragraph.
Sizes are precise non-round figures (152.3 MB, 21.5 MB, 0.04 MB) consistent with real du output, including an explicit attributed-vs-total gap breakdown per package.
